sources.used_for: Typical one-, two-, three- and four-unit layout diagrams credited to Rafael Vinoly Architects
425.5 m height, square tower, central core, 54 residential floors and nominal 812 m2 floorplate
15.5 ft typical floor-to-floor and ten-foot square windows
93.5 ft square footprint, white concrete frame, 10 in typical slabs and five two-story open mechanical bands

assumptions: Independent approximate architectural model; not an official or as-built model.
Room polygons are estimated by closing door gaps in raster plan diagrams; functions without clear evidence are explicitly unclassified or inferred.
Area and volume fields describe the modeled polygons, not certified property measurements.
The 86 model-level labels are sequential visualization indices, not actual apartment or marketing floor numbers.
The 54 residential layouts in the complete tower are seeded generated assignments of four sourced typologies; placement, orientation and furniture are synthetic.
Core outlines are regularized from the two-unit diagram and held fixed across all rotations.
Mechanical band positions, lower amenity arrangement, roof details and finish colours are approximate.
One GLB unit equals one metre; Y is up. No photographic textures, MEP networks or detailed fixtures are included.
